item.title: Temperatures return to pre Thanksgiving levels, at least for a few days
item.description: A roller coaster of temperatures is expected this week, with cold and mild air battling for control, resulting in a chilly weekend with the coldest temperatures of the season so far.

item.title: Christmas cold for this year's Springfield Christmas Parade
item.description: The Springfield Christmas Parade will take place this Saturday at 2 pm, with a theme of "Wrapped in Plaid" and temperatures expected to be below freezing.

item.title: Vacant Walgreens reopening as clinic in west Springfield
